{{Quote|Captain Solo, I thought you understood; my people are ''very'' good at not answering questions. None will violate the Silence, especially to Security Police.|[[Ewwen Glayyd|The Mor Ewwen Glayyd]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Han Solo's Revenge">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>}}
'''The Silence''' was a provision under the [[Code of Ammuud/Legends|Code of Ammuud]] that forbade members of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ammuud clans|seven clans]] from disclosing important information regarding the clan's internal affairs and dealings with others to outsiders, even if they were threatened with [[Death/Legends|death]]. The only circumstances under which a clan member could break the Silence would be in a case where a party with whom they had dealings betrayed their trust. Otherwise, any clan member who broke the Silence would be considered to have broken his or her oath under the Code of Ammuud and became an outcast.

The Silence prevented the [[Mor Glayyd|Mor]] [[Ewwen Glayyd]] from allowing [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] access to information regarding his clan's dealings with the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Zlarb/Legends|Zlarb]]. However, Solo revealed to him that Zlarb was a [[Malkite Poisoners|Malkite Poisoner]] and the [[Mor Glayyd]] eventually discovered that Zlarb had been responsible for the [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of [[Agmor Glayyd|his father]] &mdash; the previous Mor. Because of this, the Mor Glayyd furnished the information that Solo had requested and assured the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that his clan would not inform the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] of his activities during his stay on [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]].
